_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Halmstad C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). Two island platforms at street level, tracks 1/2 and 3/4, reached over the barriered crossing at their south ends (OSM footway with railway=crossing; the plan's walking route). The footbridge (OSM: layer 1, with stairs and a lift at each end) joins the station side to the bus terminal; it has no stairs down to the platforms. OSM's platform 3;4a;4b is renumbered 3;4, because the app matches tracks without their sector letter. OSM tags the east stairs layer 1 down to their foot, so the foot is joined to the street by hand.

connections.note: OSM gap: the east stairs of the footbridge are tagged layer 1 down to their foot, so the foot isn't joined to the street footway 2 m away.

sources.note: Hallandstrafiken, 'Halmstad resecentrum' map (18 August 2025; PDF supplied by the owner, also linked from Jernhusen's station page): two island platforms (1a/1b with 2, 3 with 4a/4b), the walking route over the crossing at the platforms' south end, the footbridge with stairs and a lift at each end, the ticket machine at the station house and the ticket office in the building south of it. Read off the drawing, nothing traced. Not ODbL: Hallandstrafiken hasn't licensed it; see data/stations/README.md.

Jernhusen's list (Dressinen café, Pressbyrån; no hours given, so OSM's are kept), station hours (used for the waiting room), Hallandstrafiken's ticket-office hours, toilet page (toilet and accessible toilet, card payment; not placed: no source says where). Pressbyrån's outline is its own building in OpenStreetMap.
Trafikverket TrainStation (Hd) PlatformLine 1, 1a, 1b, 2, 3, 4, 4a, 4b, TrackAtLocation values of 2026-10-21, and OSM's stop positions: tracks 1–4 west to east.

changelog.what: First map from OSM (2026-10-20 extract): platform 3;4a;4b renumbered 3;4; the east footbridge stairs joined to the street; ticket office, ticket machine, waiting room and Pressbyrån (with its OSM outline) added from Hallandstrafiken's August 2025 map and Jernhusen's pages.
